hypothesis: A false breakout through a prior channel extreme followed by a close back inside may produce short reversals with a higher share of profitable months than buy-and-hold on the same instruments.
research_subject: Larry Connors / Turtle Soup, with Linda Bradford Raschke as Street Smarts coauthor

source_audit.supports: new 20-day extreme, earlier extreme separation, reversal entry and protective stop; Plus One next-day alternative
source_audit.does_not_support: complete dated personal fills or monthly personal PnL

source_audit.supports: contemporaneous Coffee and Cotton examples of Turtle Soup Plus One signals
source_audit.does_not_support: that Connors personally executed those trades

source_audit.supports: 13F reports quarterly holdings and excludes short positions
dated entry and exit examples exist on the page
source_audit.does_not_support: independent audit, a complete personal ledger, or identification as a top-ranked US trader

novelty_check: Existing three-trader-rules and turtle-period-grid test trend-following channel breakouts; Connors RSI2 tests momentum reversal; no existing experiment tests failed channel breakouts with a prior-extreme age filter and timed exit.

corporate_actions.note: Only SFIN cash events are confirmed in this repository; other events and short dividend debits remain unverified.

grid_rationale: 20 bars follows the published channel length; 40 bars probes a slower level. Separation 3/5 brackets the published 3–4-session condition. Holds 3/6 bars bracket the stated short 2–6-day reversal horizon. These were fixed before reading the MOEX results.
baseline: Buy and hold 25% equity from first evaluable bar on the same candles and cost model
signal_rule: For each completed bar, take the previous lookback-bar low/high, excluding current bar. If current low falls below prior low but current close returns above it, and the prior low was last touched at least separation bars earlier, signal long; mirror for shorts. Enter next open. Exit after hold bars. Only one position at a time; ignore new signals while held.
original_rule_difference: The published futures rule uses intraday stop orders 5–10 ticks beyond the old extreme and a one-tick protective stop. This OHLCV adaptation requires close confirmation, enters next open and uses a fixed holding period; it is an independent hypothesis, not a replication of personal trades or fills.
cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
selection: Rank one common timeframe and parameter set by train-month positive share and mean monthly return across all eligible stocks; report late months separately; then select ten liquid equities only if data gates pass.
